name: Photorealistic LEGO
description: 포토리얼리스틱 레고 미니피규어 스타일. 레고 무비처럼 실사에 가까운 3D 레고 렌더링
scene_style_description: LEGO cinema style, characters must be in the form of LEGO head blocks, and elements must be in the form of combinations of existing LEGO blocks.

style.art_style: Photorealistic LEGO minifigure style (실사 레고 스타일)

linework.outline: Clean, defined edges with smooth plastic surface appearance, photorealistic rendering
linework.variation: Consistent LEGO brick aesthetic with realistic lighting and textures

style.shapes: Cylindrical head, rectangular body parts typical of LEGO minifigures
style.color_palette: Bright, solid plastic colors with realistic reflections and surface textures
style.shading: Photorealistic plastic sheen, soft shadows, realistic ambient occlusion
style.character_design: Classic LEGO minifigure proportions - cylindrical head with C-shaped hands, short legs. Expressive printed face on round head. Photorealistic 3D rendering like official LEGO movie
style.mood_and_tone: Photorealistic toy aesthetic, like The LEGO Movie or official LEGO promotional renders
style.background: LEGO brick elements with photorealistic rendering, realistic depth of field

technical.resolution: High quality photorealistic 3D rendered LEGO style
technical.scene_style: Photorealistic LEGO cinema style like The LEGO Movie. Characters must be realistic LEGO minifigures with plastic texture. All elements must look like real LEGO bricks photographed in real life.
